notes.title: We’re taking part in the War Child UK Armistice Sale!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967428/c6adc20792e03a966b36a35ed7c21cb34a9d455d.png[/img]
Between 8-15th November, we’ll donate a portion of every sale of Ganryu 2, Andro Dunos II, How 2 Escape and Sclash to War Child UK. Make sure to grab your discounted copy, gift one to a friend or let them know about the sale. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1284130/Sclash/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967428/77ed6fc805837e68c3b9944b9d9e3bc116bde4f4.png[/img][/url][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2264140/How_2_Escape][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967428/256ec07d4534a630c2bfaf4564a6b4bbaac1c425.png[/img][/url][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1856900/Andro_Dunos_II/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967428/0dc44e2d26f3c6ffa1584dc092dda2689ee7cb2b.png[/img][/url]

This year’s Armistice Sale is celebrating peaceful play and highlighting the importance of protecting, educating, and standing up for the rights of children living in war zones. War Child work in the hardest to reach places to support those who are hardest hit, to protect, educate and stand up for the rights of children, when they need them most. 

War Child will never give up on children affected by conflict. 
Find out more about War Child here - [url=https://www.warchild.org.uk/our-work ]https://www.warchild.org.uk/our-work [/url]

notes.title: Steam Deck is now available !
notes.notes:
Hey samurais!

Steam has reviewed our game as "Playable" on Steam Deck! 

You can now enjoy slashing from your bed! 


On another point, we wanted to share with you that Sclash, our new versus fighting game. Also inspired by Japanese culture, you can fight 1v1 with a couple of samurais, unlock new cosmetics and even more!
The game is releasing on August 4th, and will celebrate its launch at EVO!

Wishlist it now :
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1284130/Sclash/

Enjoy!

notes.title: Ganryu is on holidays!
notes.notes:
Hello ninjas!

Ganryu is now on holidays. It's time for him to slay more enemies!

The game is currently at 5 bucks during the Steam Summer Sales! There is no reason to join him !

If you got Ganryu 2 already, thank you ! 
Don't hesitate to start the game again, we've added language selection and balance a lot of things to get a funniest experience!

notes.title: Ganryu 1.2.0 - Language Selection!
notes.notes:
Hello ninjas!

Hope you're all doing well!

As we're just celebrating the first year of Ganryu release, we're happy to add the Language selection menu that was requested ages ago! 

Sorry for being so long to implement this, but our small dev team was working on new projects actively and we took a small time to fix the bugs remaining and add this awaited language menu as well as the button remapping! You can now enjoy Ganryu the way you want, in the language you want!

See you in Japan!

notes.title: Patchnote : 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello Ninjas,

[h1]Welcome to the first patch note of Ganryu 2. We hope you'll like the 1.1.0 version![/h1]

[h2]In details: [/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced HP of Mid Boss on Stage 4
[*] Several small bug fixes
[*] Fixed a bug that could lead to a softlock of the game before the boss fight of Stage 2
[*] Fixed a bug that could lead to a softlock of the game after defeating the boss of Stage 3
[*] Fixed a bug with Mid Boss 5 that could lead to an unexpected death of it
[*] Some Level Design changes, mostly on Stages 4 and 5, that should reduce the difficulty to an acceptable level
[*] Small changes on some enemies' IA
[*] Fixed an issue in the "Remap Controls" Menu
[/list]

We hope you'll like new enhancements! More to follow in the coming days... 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967428/2cedc0f1152ccea1cb5f005f0fddd139a7790b27.gif[/img]

notes.title: Ganryu 2 is releasing on April 22, 2022 !
notes.notes:
[h3]Ganryu 2 is the sequel to the Ganryu game made by VISCO on NEOGEO back in 1999. The universe takes place in a feudal fantasy Japan which is strongly inspired by the story of Takezo Musashi, whose adventures are unfolded in a series of books (mainly "The Stone and the Sword").[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967428/2cedc0f1152ccea1cb5f005f0fddd139a7790b27.gif[/img]

[h2]Play as Miyamoto Musashi travelling through a 17th century fantasy Japan, from north to south to the island of Ganryu-jima where everything started between Musashi and Kojiro.[/h2]

After his victory against Kojiro, Musashi decided to meditate and try his hand at art, in the north of Japan, in the province of Hokkaido. During one of his meditations, a spirit contacted him : "Miyamoto Musashi, our fight is not over, I am waiting for you to finish our fight once and for all! All of Japan will pay for your insult! I'm waiting for you Miyamoto Musashi!” 
There is no doubt for Musashi that the voice was the Sasaki Kojirō’s one. His body was defeated, but his spirit remains, and his intentions are still destructive. Miyamoto Musashi then understood that he would have to travel across Japan from north to south and go to the island of Ganryû-jima, where he firstly defeated Sasaki Kojirō, to fight again and liberate the spirit of Kojiro forever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967428/7a1b0219693d953ad5ccd75be9c66dfb5d1e251a.gif[/img]

[h2]More info & wishlist it now ![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1856910/Ganryu_2


Stay tuned for more content around Ganryu !
